front: A startup captou vinte milhões de reais na última rodada de investimento.
pronunciation: ah stahr-TAH-pee kahp-TOH VEEN-chee mee-LYOYNGZ jee rreh-AHYS nah OOL-chee-mah rroh-DAH-dah jee een-vehs-chee-MEHN-too.
back: The startup raised twenty million reais in its latest funding round.
context: 'Captar' = to raise (funds). 'Rodada de investimento' = funding round. Brazilians say 'startup' with a feminine article: 'a startup'.

front: O aporte veio de um fundo de capital de risco com foco em fintechs.
pronunciation: oo ah-POHR-chee VAY-oo jee oong FOON-doo jee kah-pee-TOW jee RREES-koo kohng FOH-koo eng FEEN-tehks.
back: The investment came from a venture capital fund focused on fintechs.
context: 'Aporte' = capital injection. 'Capital de risco' = venture capital. Brazil has one of the largest fintech markets in the world.

front: Nosso desafio agora é escalar o negócio sem perder a qualidade.
pronunciation: NOH-soo deh-zah-FEE-oo ah-GOH-rah EH ehs-kah-LAHR oo neh-GOH-syoo seng pehr-DEHR ah kwah-lee-DAH-jee.
back: Our challenge now is to scale the business without losing quality.
context: 'Escalar' (to climb) is used in business for 'to scale'.

front: O faturamento cresceu, mas a margem de lucro encolheu.
pronunciation: oo fah-too-rah-MEHN-too kreh-SEH-oo, mahz ah MAHR-zheng jee LOO-kroo ehn-koh-LYEH-oo.
back: Revenue grew, but the profit margin shrank.
context: 'Faturamento' = revenue/turnover. 'Lucro' = profit. 'Encolher' = to shrink.

front: Precisamos garantir uma receita recorrente para reduzir a volatilidade.
pronunciation: preh-see-ZAH-mooz gah-rahn-CHEER OO-mah rreh-SAY-tah rreh-koh-RREHN-chee PAH-rah rreh-doo-ZEER ah voh-lah-chee-lee-DAH-jee.
back: We need to secure recurring revenue to reduce volatility.
context: 'Receita' = revenue (also recipe or prescription!). 'Receita recorrente' = subscriptions, contracts, etc.

front: O fluxo de caixa está negativo há três trimestres.
pronunciation: oo FLOOK-soo jee KAHY-shah ehs-TAH neh-gah-CHEE-voo AH TREHS tree-MEHS-trees.
back: Cash flow has been negative for three quarters.
context: 'Caixa' = cash (also cashier, box). 'Há' + time + present = for (ongoing period).

front: A diretoria anunciou um plano de reestruturação para enxugar custos.
pronunciation: ah jee-reh-toh-REE-ah ah-noon-SYOH oong PLAH-noo jee rreh-ehs-troo-too-rah-SOWNG PAH-rah ehn-shoo-GAHR KOOS-toos.
back: The board announced a restructuring plan to cut costs.
context: 'Enxugar' (to dry off) = to trim, streamline. 'Diretoria' = executive board.

front: A empresa entrou com pedido de recuperação judicial.
pronunciation: ah ehm-PREH-zah ehn-TROH kohng peh-JEE-doo jee rreh-koo-peh-rah-SOWNG zhoo-jee-SYOW.
back: The company filed for court-supervised restructuring.
context: 'Recuperação judicial' is the Brazilian equivalent of Chapter 11, a step before 'falência' (bankruptcy).

front: Vamos renegociar as dívidas com os credores para alongar os prazos.
pronunciation: VAH-mooz rreh-neh-goh-see-AHR ahz JEE-vee-dahs kohng ooz kreh-DOH-reez PAH-rah ah-lohn-GAHR oos PRAH-zoos.
back: We're going to renegotiate the debts with creditors to extend the terms.
context: 'Credor' = creditor; 'devedor' = debtor. 'Alongar prazos' = to extend repayment terms.

front: O conselho de administração aprovou a fusão com a concorrente.
pronunciation: oo kohn-SEH-lyoo jee ahj-mee-nees-trah-SOWNG ah-proh-VOH ah foo-ZOWNG kohng ah kohn-koh-RREHN-chee.
back: The board of directors approved the merger with the competitor.
context: 'Conselho de administração' = board of directors (above the 'diretoria'). 'Fusão' = merger; 'aquisição' = acquisition.

front: A aquisição precisa ser aprovada pelo Cade antes de ser concluída.
pronunciation: ah ah-kee-zee-SOWNG preh-SEE-zah SEHR ah-proh-VAH-dah PEH-loo KAH-jee AHN-cheez jee SEHR kohn-kloo-EE-dah.
back: The acquisition must be approved by CADE before it can be completed.
context: CADE is Brazil's antitrust authority.

front: Nossa governança precisa ser mais transparente para atrair investidores.
pronunciation: NOH-sah goh-vehr-NAHN-sah preh-SEE-zah SEHR MAHYS trahns-pah-REHN-chee PAH-rah ah-trah-EER een-vehs-chee-DOH-rees.
back: Our governance needs to be more transparent to attract investors.
context: 'Governança corporativa' = corporate governance. Brazilian business Portuguese also uses 'compliance' directly.

front: O setor de compliance barrou o contrato por conflito de interesses.
pronunciation: oo seh-TOHR jee kohm-PLAHY-ahns bah-RROH oo kohn-TRAH-too pohr kohn-FLEE-too jee een-teh-REH-sees.
back: The compliance department blocked the contract due to a conflict of interest.
context: 'Barrar' = to block, stop. 'Conflito de interesses' = conflict of interest.

front: Um bom líder sabe delegar e confiar na equipe.
pronunciation: oong BOHNG LEE-dehr SAH-bee deh-leh-GAHR ee kohn-fee-AHR nah eh-KEE-pee.
back: A good leader knows how to delegate and trust the team.
context: 'Saber' + infinitive = to know how to. 'Confiar em' = to trust.

front: Delegar não é largar: é preciso acompanhar sem microgerenciar.
pronunciation: deh-leh-GAHR NOWNG EH lahr-GAHR: EH preh-SEE-zoo ah-kohm-pah-NYAHR seng mee-kroh-zheh-rehn-see-AHR.
back: Delegating isn't abandoning: you need to follow up without micromanaging.
context: Wordplay: 'delegar' vs 'largar' (to drop, let go). 'Microgerenciar' = to micromanage.

front: Vou te passar essa demanda, e você tem autonomia para decidir o caminho.
pronunciation: VOH chee pah-SAHR EH-sah deh-MAHN-dah, ee voh-SEH teng ow-toh-noh-MEE-ah PAH-rah deh-see-JEER oo kah-MEE-nyoo.
back: I'm handing this task over to you, and you're free to decide how to approach it.
context: 'Demanda' = task, request (very common in Brazilian offices). 'Ter autonomia' = to be empowered to decide.

front: Quais são os indicadores que vamos usar para medir o sucesso?
pronunciation: KWAHYS SOWNG ooz een-jee-kah-DOH-rees keh VAH-mooz oo-ZAHR PAH-rah meh-JEER oo soo-SEH-soo?
back: Which indicators are we going to use to measure success?
context: 'Indicadores' = KPIs/metrics (Brazilians also say 'KPIs', pronounced 'kah-peh-EES').

front: Batemos a meta do trimestre com folga.
pronunciation: bah-CHEE-mooz ah MEH-tah doo tree-MEHS-tree kohng FOHL-gah.
back: We hit the quarter's target comfortably.
context: 'Bater a meta' = to hit the target. 'Com folga' = with room to spare.

front: Precisamos alinhar as expectativas antes de fechar o escopo.
pronunciation: preh-see-ZAH-mooz ah-lee-NYAHR ahz ehs-pehk-tah-CHEE-vahz AHN-cheez jee feh-SHAHR oo ehs-KOH-poo.
back: We need to align expectations before closing the scope.
context: 'Alinhar' (to align) is a favorite corporate verb in Brazil: 'vamos alinhar' = let's get on the same page.

front: Foi uma decisão estratégica, não apenas financeira.
pronunciation: FOY OO-mah deh-see-ZOWNG ehs-trah-TEH-zhee-kah, NOWNG ah-PEH-nahs fee-nahn-SAY-rah.
back: It was a strategic decision, not just a financial one.
context: 'Não apenas' = not just/only.

front: A empresa decidiu pivotar o modelo de negócio para o B2B.
pronunciation: ah ehm-PREH-zah deh-see-JEE-oo pee-voh-TAHR oo moh-DEH-loo jee neh-GOH-syoo PAH-rah oo beh-DOYS-beh.
back: The company decided to pivot its business model to B2B.
context: 'Pivotar' = to pivot (startup jargon). 'B2B' is read 'bê dois bê'.

front: O mercado está saturado; precisamos de um diferencial competitivo.
pronunciation: oo mehr-KAH-doo ehs-TAH sah-too-RAH-doo; preh-see-ZAH-mooz jee oong jee-feh-rehn-SYOW kohm-peh-chee-CHEE-voo.
back: The market is saturated; we need a competitive edge.
context: 'Diferencial' = differentiator, edge (used as a noun).

front: O Brasil já tem mais de uma dezena de startups unicórnio.
pronunciation: oo brah-ZEE-oo ZHAH teng MAHYZ jee OO-mah deh-ZEH-nah jee stahr-TAH-peez oo-nee-KOHR-nyoo.
back: Brazil already has more than a dozen unicorn startups.
context: 'Unicórnio' = startup valued at over a billion dollars. 'Dezena' = a set of ten.

front: A inteligência artificial vai transformar a forma como trabalhamos.
pronunciation: ah een-teh-lee-ZHEHN-syah ahr-chee-fee-SYOW VAHY trahns-fohr-MAHR ah FOHR-mah KOH-moo trah-bah-LYAH-moos.
back: Artificial intelligence will transform the way we work.
context: 'A forma como' = the way (that). Brazilians usually say 'IA' (ee-AH).

front: Estamos investindo pesado em automação para ganhar eficiência.
pronunciation: ehs-TAH-mooz een-vehs-CHEEN-doo peh-ZAH-doo eng ow-toh-mah-SOWNG PAH-rah gah-NYAHR eh-fee-see-EHN-syah.
back: We're investing heavily in automation to become more efficient.
context: 'Investir pesado' = to invest heavily ('pesado' as an adverb).

front: O corte de pessoal deve ser a última opção, não a primeira.
pronunciation: oo KOHR-chee jee peh-soh-AHL DEH-vee SEHR ah OOL-chee-mah ohp-SOWNG, NOWNG ah pree-MAY-rah.
back: Cutting staff should be the last option, not the first.
context: 'Corte de pessoal' = layoffs. 'Pessoal' as a noun = staff, personnel.

front: Precisamos comunicar a mudança com clareza para evitar boatos.
pronunciation: preh-see-ZAH-mooz koh-moo-nee-KAHR ah moo-DAHN-sah kohng klah-REH-zah PAH-rah eh-vee-TAHR boh-AH-toos.
back: We need to communicate the change clearly to avoid rumors.
context: 'Boato' = rumor. Change management starts with honest communication.

front: Ele é ótimo tecnicamente, mas ainda precisa desenvolver habilidades de gestão.
pronunciation: EH-lee EH OH-chee-moo tehk-nee-kah-MEHN-chee, mahz ah-EEN-dah preh-SEE-zah deh-zehn-vohl-VEHR ah-bee-lee-DAH-jeez jee zhehs-TOWNG.
back: He's great technically, but still needs to develop management skills.
context: 'Gestão' = management. Typical performance-review sentence.

front: Na reunião de resultados, apresentamos o balanço do ano aos acionistas.
pronunciation: nah rreh-oo-nee-OWNG jee rreh-zool-TAH-doos, ah-preh-zehn-TAH-mooz oo bah-LAHN-soo doo AH-noo ah-ooz ah-syoh-NEES-tahs.
back: At the results meeting, we presented the year's balance sheet to the shareholders.
context: 'Balanço' = balance sheet/financial results. 'Acionista' = shareholder.

front: As ações da empresa despencaram após a divulgação do prejuízo.
pronunciation: ahz ah-SOYNGZ dah ehm-PREH-zah jehs-pehn-KAH-rowng ah-POHZ ah jee-vool-gah-SOWNG doo preh-zhoo-EE-zoo.
back: The company's shares plummeted after the loss was announced.
context: 'Ações' = shares (also actions). 'Despencar' = to plummet. 'Prejuízo' = loss (opposite of 'lucro').

front: O CEO assumiu a responsabilidade pelo erro em vez de culpar a equipe.
pronunciation: oo see-ee-OH ah-soo-MEE-oo ah rrehs-pohn-sah-bee-lee-DAH-jee PEH-loo EH-rroo eng VEHS jee kool-PAHR ah eh-KEE-pee.
back: The CEO took responsibility for the mistake instead of blaming the team.
context: 'Assumir a responsabilidade' = to take responsibility. Brazilians usually say CEO in English (see-ee-OH).

front: Liderar pelo exemplo vale mais do que mil discursos.
pronunciation: lee-deh-RAHR PEH-loo eh-ZEHM-ploo VAH-lee MAHYZ doo keh MEE-oo jees-KOOR-soos.
back: Leading by example is worth more than a thousand speeches.
context: 'Valer mais do que' = to be worth more than.

front: Toda crise também é uma oportunidade de repensar processos.
pronunciation: TOH-dah KREE-zee tahm-BENG EH OO-mah oh-pohr-too-nee-DAH-jee jee rreh-pehn-SAHR proh-SEH-soos.
back: Every crisis is also an opportunity to rethink processes.
context: 'Toda' + singular noun without article = every. 'Repensar' = to rethink.

front: Vamos fazer um piloto antes de implementar em todas as filiais.
pronunciation: VAH-mooz fah-ZEHR oong pee-LOH-too AHN-cheez jee eem-pleh-mehn-TAHR eng TOH-dahs ahs fee-lee-AHYS.
back: Let's run a pilot before rolling it out to all branches.
context: 'Piloto' = pilot project. 'Filial' = branch office (headquarters = 'matriz' or 'sede').

front: O retorno sobre o investimento só virá no longo prazo.
pronunciation: oo rreh-TOHR-noo SOH-bree oo een-vehs-chee-MEHN-too SOH vee-RAH noo LOHN-goo PRAH-zoo.
back: The return on investment will only come in the long term.
context: 'Retorno sobre o investimento' = ROI. 'A longo prazo' and 'no longo prazo' are both used.

front: Precisamos de um plano B caso a parceria não se concretize.
pronunciation: preh-see-ZAH-mooz jee oong PLAH-noo BEH KAH-zoo ah pahr-seh-REE-ah NOWNG see kohn-kreh-CHEE-zee.
back: We need a plan B in case the partnership doesn't materialize.
context: 'Caso' + subjunctive = in case. 'Concretizar-se' = to materialize.

front: A cultura organizacional devora a estratégia no café da manhã.
pronunciation: ah kool-TOO-rah ohr-gah-nee-zah-syoh-NOW deh-VOH-rah ah ehs-trah-TEH-zhyah noo kah-FEH dah mah-NYAH.
back: Culture eats strategy for breakfast.
context: Translation of the quote attributed to Peter Drucker, very popular in Brazilian management talks.

front: Os colaboradores precisam se sentir ouvidos e valorizados.
pronunciation: ooz koh-lah-boh-rah-DOH-rees preh-SEE-zowng see sehn-CHEER oh-VEE-dooz ee vah-loh-ree-ZAH-doos.
back: Employees need to feel heard and valued.
context: Brazilian companies prefer 'colaboradores' (collaborators) to 'funcionários' (employees).

front: A rotatividade alta está custando caro para a empresa.
pronunciation: ah rroh-tah-chee-vee-DAH-jee AHL-tah ehs-TAH koos-TAHN-doo KAH-roo PAH-rah ah ehm-PREH-zah.
back: High staff turnover is costing the company dearly.
context: 'Rotatividade' = turnover (also 'turnover' in corporate speech). 'Custar caro' = to cost dearly.

front: Dar feedback negativo exige empatia e objetividade.
pronunciation: DAHR fee-BEH-kee neh-gah-CHEE-voo eh-ZEE-zhee ehm-pah-CHEE-ah ee ohb-zheh-chee-vee-DAH-jee.
back: Giving negative feedback requires empathy and objectivity.
context: 'Feedback' is fully adopted in Brazilian Portuguese, pronounced roughly 'fee-BEH-kee'.

front: Nada de reuniões sem pauta: tempo também é recurso.
pronunciation: NAH-dah jee rreh-oo-nee-OYNGS seng POW-tah: TEHM-poo tahm-BENG EH rreh-KOOR-soo.
back: No meetings without an agenda: time is also a resource.
context: 'Pauta' = meeting agenda (also news agenda). 'Nada de' + noun = no more…

front: Precisamos tirar o projeto do papel ainda este semestre.
pronunciation: preh-see-ZAH-mooz chee-RAHR oo proh-ZHEH-too doo pah-PEH-oo ah-EEN-dah EHS-chee seh-MEHS-tree.
back: We need to get the project off the ground this semester.
context: 'Tirar do papel' (take off the paper) = to put a plan into action.

front: A sucessão na liderança foi planejada com dois anos de antecedência.
pronunciation: ah soo-seh-SOWNG nah lee-deh-RAHN-sah FOY plah-neh-ZHAH-dah kohng DOYZ AH-nooz jee ahn-teh-seh-DEHN-syah.
back: The leadership succession was planned two years in advance.
context: 'Sucessão' = succession; family businesses in Brazil often struggle with it.

front: Errar rápido e barato faz parte da cultura de inovação.
pronunciation: eh-RRAHR RRAH-pee-doo ee bah-RAH-too FAHS PAHR-chee dah kool-TOO-rah jee ee-noh-vah-SOWNG.
back: Failing fast and cheaply is part of an innovation culture.
context: Adjectives used as adverbs ('rápido', 'barato') are common in speech. 'Fazer parte de' = to be part of.

front: No fim das contas, quem decide é o cliente.
pronunciation: noo FEENG dahs KOHN-tahs, KENG deh-SEE-jee EH oo klee-EHN-chee.
back: At the end of the day, it's the customer who decides.
context: 'No fim das contas' = at the end of the day, ultimately.
